brandPositioningSummary: voco is a premium conversion-oriented soft brand within IHG within IHG Hotels & Resorts. For owners, the affiliation case is conversion and repositioning fit, retained property character, IHG platform access, standards and flexibility diligence, and market positioning versus boutique or soft-collection alternatives. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among Hotel Indigo, Kimpton, Vignette Collection, Holiday Inn.

scenarios.title: Upscale independent conversion
scenarios.summary: An independent or lightly branded upscale hotel seeking IHG distribution while keeping a distinctive identity. voco is relevant when conversion standards are achievable without forcing a hard-brand prototype, and when the property’s character can remain visible after affiliation. Owners should diligence whether voco is a better fit than Hotel Indigo for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: Urban repositioning with premium soft brand
scenarios.summary: A city hotel that needs a clearer premium guest promise and commercial platform. voco can fit when owners want conversion speed and flexible design application, while still underwriting service, public-space, and systems obligations carefully. Owners should diligence whether voco is a better fit than Hotel Indigo for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: CALA conversion growth path
scenarios.summary: Mexico and broader CALA conversion opportunities where owners want an IHG premium brand rather than Holiday Inn or Hotel Indigo. Use open examples such as Mexico City Reforma and treat signed pipeline hotels as dated momentum, not already-open inventory. Owners should diligence whether voco is a better fit than Hotel Indigo for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.
